provenance.jvNote: The JV tables are the sheet’s JV Place and JV Record columns, in its JV order.
notes: Official BVAL sheet titled "BVAL Girls Volleyball / 2025 - 26 Team Standings", linked from bval.org/standings. Varsity order is the sheet's own "Place".
Records only: the sheet has Overall and League Record per school and no points, goals or tiebreak data, so none are stored or computed.
Records are written as the sheet prints them (W-L), without the spaces around each hyphen; the sport has no ties, so t is 0.

Places are the sheet's, ties included: Westmont and Christopher (4); Piedmont Hills and Sobrato (8); Lincoln and Pioneer (1); Prospect and Gilroy (3); San Jose and Live Oak (2); Mt. Pleasant and James Lick (8). A tied place is stored as printed, and the next place skips.

The 2025-26 divisions are the sheet's (Mt. Hamilton; Santa Teresa; West Valley), not 2026-27's in lib/registry/volleyball/bval.ts. Almaden Valley did not exist in 2025-26. Filed elsewhere in 2026-27: Christopher (Mt. Hamilton), Silver Creek (Mt. Hamilton), Piedmont Hills (Mt. Hamilton), Sobrato (Mt. Hamilton), Lincoln (Santa Teresa), Pioneer (Santa Teresa), Prospect (Santa Teresa), Willow Glen (Santa Teresa), Gunderson (Santa Teresa), Yerba Buena (Santa Teresa), Andrew Hill (Santa Teresa), Santa Teresa (West Valley), Live Oak (West Valley), Del Mar (West Valley). The registry is not changed; the page says these teams moved.

JV is stored from the JV Place and JV Record columns, ordered on the JV place (the sheet's row order among equal places); tied JV places: Branham and Silver Creek (1); Westmont and Piedmont Hills (5); Del Mar and Independence (2); Oak Grove and Mt. Pleasant (7).
The sheet leaves the Overall cell empty for Gunderson: overallRecord is null.
No all-league awards: this sport's BVAL all-league documents are not transcribed, so every division's awards are null.

provenance.extraction: Standings: pdftotext -layout. All-league awards: By hand, from pdftotext -layout of each PDF; each row is [player, school, position, year] as printed.
notes: SCVAL girls volleyball, from scval.com/standings. Rows are in the PDF's own "SCHOOL by finish" order; nothing is recomputed, since the PDF carries no game-level data.
The PDF's "Overall record" column is empty, so every overallRecord is null.
Division membership is the 2025-26 PDF's, which is not the 2026-27 alignment; the page says which teams moved.
School spellings are the documents' own ("Mt. View", "Monta VIsta"); `slug` is the join key.
Grades are stored as 9-12 whatever the document wrote ("Jr", "Junior", "Soph", "Frosh", "11").
An overall award is stored as "Player, School, Position, Grade" from the document's four cells. Two players named for one award are two entries under the same title.
Records are W-L: a volleyball match cannot end level, so the PDF prints no ties and t is stored as 0.
The standings PDF's file name reads "2025-25"; its title and its rows are 2025-26's.

Each all-league document names an MVP and one all-league team with an honorable mention from each school; the varsity documents also name an Outstanding Senior, Junior, Sophomore and Freshman, who are on the team or the honorable mention list too. There is no second team.
The De Anza documents print a player's graduating class ("2028"), the El Camino ones her grade ("10"); both are stored as the grade.
The El Camino JV document spells Saratoga "Saratgoa" and prints the year of one of its players as "7", which is no high school grade, so that row has none.
The El Camino varsity document prints its Outstanding Freshman's position over two lines ("OH/O" and "PP"), read as OH/OPP.
JV membership is varsity's in both divisions.
